heading: Today
text: Areas of dense fog and low clouds giving way to lots of sunshine, mixing with afternoon clouds.  Highs in the 70s to near 80.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Tonight
text: Fair early, then increasing clouds southwest to northeast.  A rising chance of showers through NY, east to I-89 by morning.  Lows in the 50s, a few upper 40s northeast.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Tuesday
text: Showers likely through NY and from I-89 south, diminishing in the afternoon.  A chance of showers in Quebec, and northeast, mainly afternoon.  Highs in the upper 60s to mid 70s, coolest south.  Winds light, mainly southeast less than 10 mph.
